explanation: W = 1.45 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold (1.4861 GeV), so this final state cannot be produced at this kinematic point; the request is physically impossible, not merely out of table range. The eta lookup table also only covers W in [1.4856, 6.0000] GeV, confirming no valid calculation exists at W = 1.45 GeV. No EXCLURAD run was performed.
